name: Circadian and PPARA/PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members are transcriptional regulators of metabolism (PPARA, PGC-1alpha, mitochondrial biogenesis, ROR/REV-ERB, heme sensing); circadian BMAL1/CLOCK output and heme signaling separate it from the LXR, adipogenesis and gluconeogenesis neighbours, while the PPAR/PGC-1alpha arm separates it from the core-clock theme.

name: eNOS-derived nitric oxide signaling via cGMP
rationale: All members concern nitric oxide production by NOS and its cGMP-mediated signal transduction; eNOS activation and NO biosynthesis distinguish it from neighbours centred on smooth muscle contraction, renal cGMP effects and eNOS trafficking.

qualifier: end trimming, splicing, nuclear and mitochondrial
name: tRNA end trimming, splicing and mitochondrial tRNA maturation
rationale: Members are pre-tRNA processing steps (5' leader removal, 3' end processing, intron splicing, tRF generation) in nucleus and mitochondria; end processing and splicing distinguish it from neighbours about tRNA aminoacylation, base modification and pseudouridylation.

qualifier: glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid, CYP enzyme defects
name: Adrenal glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis, including CYP enzyme defects
rationale: Members cover cortisol and aldosterone synthesis, its regulation and the steroidogenic CYP deficiencies of congenital adrenal hyperplasia; the aldosterone/mineralocorticoid arm separates it from sex-steroid and pregnenolone neighbours, and the biosynthetic enzyme defects from the aldosterone-response neighbour.

name: MET and ERBB-family receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are RTK activation and adaptor events (GRB2, SHC1, PI3K, PLCG1, STAT3) leading to AKT and ERK, dominated by MET and EGFR/ERBB2-4 receptors; these receptor families distinguish it from PTK6- and IGF1R-centred neighbours.

name: Eph-ephrin repulsion in axon fasciculation and neuronal pruning
rationale: Members concern Eph-ephrin contact repulsion and growth cone collapse shaping axon fasciculation, synapse pruning and neuron remodeling; repulsion and pruning distinguish it from neighbours with DCC/netrin attraction, L1 or Sema3A signaling.

name: E2F-regulated DNA replication initiation and cell cycle progression
rationale: Members are E2F target programmes, G1/S and G2/M promotion and initiation of mitotic DNA replication with origin unwinding; replication initiation and E2F1/E2F6 targets distinguish it from neighbours on E2F/DREAM transcriptional repression and replication-stress checkpoints.

name: Regulation of RNA polymerase II transcription initiation
rationale: Members share control of Pol II transcription at promoters (preinitiation complex assembly, initiation surveillance, transcription factor and chromatin modules feeding transcription); the initiation focus distinguishes it from neighbours centred on elongation, pausing and termination.

qualifier: inner and middle ear, hair cell fate
name: Inner and middle ear morphogenesis and hair cell specification
rationale: All members concern formation of the otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canals, middle ear, vestibulocochlear nerve and auditory hair cell fate; this ear focus separates it from neighbours on olfactory, eye and other cranial sensory development.

name: Epinephrine signaling and alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of secretion
rationale: Members concern adrenoceptor responses to epinephrine including alpha-2-mediated suppression of catecholamine and insulin secretion; this secretory feedback distinguishes it from cardiac beta-adrenergic and generic Gi/adenylate-cyclase-inhibition neighbours.

name: Definitive endoderm formation and early pancreatic progenitor lineages
rationale: Members span definitive endoderm specification, foregut morphogenesis, pluripotency-driven proliferation and multipotent/ductal/endocrine progenitor lineages; the pancreatic progenitor stage separates it from gastrulation neighbours and the endoderm stage from late pancreatic differentiation neighbours.

name: Insulin receptor signal tuning and adiponectin-regulated glucose import
rationale: Members regulate insulin receptor/IRS signaling and its attenuation, glucose import and glycogen synthesis, with adiponectin signaling; IRS attenuation and adiponectin distinguish it from AKT2/GLUT4 translocation neighbours and from glucagon/gluconeogenesis neighbours.

name: Cytomegalovirus infection, latency and host antiviral restriction
rationale: Members concern HCMV early and late events, viral latency, host suppression of viral transcription and LRRFIP1-driven interferon induction; this herpesvirus context distinguishes it from retroviral (HIV) integration and replication neighbours.

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation, including snoRNP-guided rRNA modification
rationale: Members are chemical modifications of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and mRNA (2'-O-methylation, base methylation, pseudouridylation) plus snoRNP assembly and localization; nucleotide modification distinguishes it from rRNA cleavage/decay, Cajal body, tRNA processing and mitochondrial RNA neighbours.

name: Endothelin-dependent enteric nervous system development and gut motility
rationale: Members cover enteric neural crest migration, endothelin signaling, gut development, peristalsis, GI smooth muscle contraction and gastric secretion; endothelin and gastric motility distinguish it from RET/GDNF neighbours, and the gut context from urinary and vascular endothelin neighbours.

name: Centrosome positioning and MTOC microtubule nucleation and anchoring
rationale: Members concern centrosome localization and cohesion, microtubule nucleation, anchoring and stabilization at the MTOC and cortex; positioning and nucleation distinguish it from spindle orientation, tubulin modification, cilia/centriole duplication and mitotic centrosome maturation neighbours.

name: Noncoding RNA control of PTEN and PI3K-AKT suppression
rationale: Members concern PTEN-mediated restraint of PI3K-AKT/IGF receptor signaling, its loss in cancer and ceRNA/lncRNA regulation of PTEN translation; the RNA-level control distinguishes it from neighbours on PTEN localization/stability and inositol phosphate metabolism.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuronal development
name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification and patterning
rationale: Members cover motor neuron and interneuron specification, neural tube dorsoventral patterning, brainstem and cranial/sensory ganglion development and brainstem-controlled behaviours; this hindbrain-spinal scope separates it from enteric, neural plate, midbrain and cranial sensory neighbours.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: HGF-MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are MET activation and its effectors plus related RTKs (MST1/RON, ALK/LTK) driving PI3K-AKT and ERK; the MET focus distinguishes it from ERBB-, PTK6- and IGF1R-centred neighbours.

name: Recombination-dependent DNA repair synthesis and strand invasion
rationale: Members concern homology-directed repair (strand invasion, break-induced replication, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange, cross-link repair) and associated repair DNA synthesis; this distinguishes it from NHEJ/DSB-sensing neighbours and checkpoint/cell-division neighbours.

name: MHC class II presentation of exogenous peptide antigens
rationale: All members concern loading and presentation of exogenous peptides on MHC class II, including in germinal center B cells; class II distinguishes it from MHC class I cross-presentation and regulatory neighbours.

name: IL-23/IL-12 signaling and the IL-17-Th17 response
rationale: Members cover IL-23 and IL-12 receptor signaling, IL-17 signaling and production and Th17 lineage commitment; the IL-23/IL-12 arm distinguishes it from IL-10/IL-27 neighbours and the IL-17/Th17 arm from IL-1-family and antifungal lectin neighbours.

name: Vascular smooth muscle contractility in arterial pressure control
rationale: Members concern contraction and relaxation of vascular smooth muscle (actin-myosin movement, cGMP effects, vasoconstriction) and arterial pressure regulation by endothelin and catecholamines; the contractile machinery distinguishes it from eNOS/pulmonary pressure neighbours and adrenergic receptor neighbours.

name: Mismatch repair and B cell immunoglobulin diversification
rationale: Members are mismatch repair and its inherited defects together with somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J recombination and B lineage commitment; the B cell diversification arm separates it from proliferating T cell and TGF-beta mutant neighbours, and the MMR arm from base excision repair and APOBEC editing neighbours.

name: Insulin receptor signaling to glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
rationale: Members span insulin receptor/IRS/AKT2 signaling, receptor recycling, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin effects; this insulin-anabolic focus distinguishes it from glucagon, glycogenolysis and ChREBP/gluconeogenesis neighbours.
